none: PAS NLM-24DA92: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right, Reece period 19. Chipped. This coin was kindly examined by Cliff Reeves. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]VALEN[--]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 12
